snippet.title: What If Mini Motorways Had Public Transport? | Multi Modal Transit
snippet.description:
I loved playing Mini Motorways, but it always frustrated me that it didn’t have public transport. So I decided to make my own game which allowed me to keep growing cities moving with public transport. It’s now available on the App Store for iOS and Mac OS. 

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/multi-modal-transit/id6797282707

Multi Modal Transit puts you in charge of a growing city’s transport network using roads, buses, trams, underground lines and river boats.

It starts off pretty straightforward. Then the city grows, traffic builds up, queues appear, and suddenly that route you thought was perfect isn’t looking quite so clever anymore. As you survive each day, you can unlock further roads, bridges or public transit.

There are currently seven cities to play, including London, Las Vegas, Venice, Rio, Stockholm, Mexico City and San Francisco. 

The London map is completely free, with no ads, account or time limit. One optional purchase unlocks the other cities plus Sandbox and Custom modes.
